slice: tamper-evident exact-commit workflow enumeration evidence bundle
finding: The existing reconciliation gate could decide agreement but did not define a durable retention object binding both raw enumerations, source methods, retrieval times, and canonical digests. The new bundle contract preserves that chain and fails closed on divergence, provider-ceiling ambiguity, invalid commit identity, invalid timestamps, or unapproved source methods.

verification.route: isolated Node execution against the committed implementation contract and existing reconciler interface
cases: matching independently complete enumerations produce strong evidence
canonical hashing is stable across object key ordering
metadata divergence fails closed while preserving digests
connector snapshots and other unapproved source methods are rejected

privacy_boundary: The manifest stores source method, retrieval time, page count, commit identity, canonical SHA-256 digests, and reconciliation result. It forbids secrets and does not require tokens, request headers, or private repository payloads inside the bundle.
limits: No authenticated exhaustive enumeration was executed in this slice.
No gh api --paginate output was captured.
No Vercel deployment was attempted because the provider-capacity constraint remains active.
Canonical digests prove retained-object identity only when the raw objects are also preserved.
